propositions: The workflow editor must expose authored YAML/BPMN as the only editable topology while providing a separate read-only Effective Policy view derived from CriteriaSnapshot that never serializes edits back into the workflow.
Project code-review LLM criteria save-validation must reject missing, empty, non-list, or blank applies_to glob lists and offer the remedy use ["**"] for repository-wide applicability.

Effective Policy rendering must display criterion digest/source, gate, execution tier, posture, applicability summary, and enabled/disabled state with concise derived reason, but must never include execution traces or per-call debugging details.
Snapshot load or validation failures must mark the Effective Policy view unavailable with an actionable located error and must never substitute packaged defaults or permit an invalid save.
Built-in secondary triggers, project DET selector controls, and plan-review applies_at/trigger authoring must remain unaffected by the project-LLM glob validation rule.
The authored workflow document must round-trip byte-equivalently while the derived Effective Policy view changes with project policy updates.
